spec.abstain_behavior: Returns should_call_tool false with explicit abstain_reason on no_records, no_matching_constraints, invalid_selection_mode, no_numeric_timestamps, ambiguous_timestamp_tie, missing target ids, missing update fields, missing message content/recipient, or unsupported_action. For post-selection issues such as missing update fields it still returns selected_record, selected_id, selected_timestamp, and downstream_tool_name so the actor can compute missing updates or use the selected target without redoing recency comparison.
spec.description: Call after a search tool returns visible records when the next step is to modify or remove the latest/oldest contact or reminder. It selects one record by timestamp, prepares downstream tool kwargs when fields are available, and abstains on missing records, ties, or search-only questions. Do not call for pure search answers.
spec.final_state_preservation_plan: The helper never performs side effects. It returns downstream_tool_name and downstream_tool_kwargs so the original ToolSandbox side-effect tool is still called exactly once by the actor.
spec.generalization_rationale: Selector-only recombination after expanded60 diagnosis: the resolver had net-negative called subset, and the contact-specific bridge was negative under force-call. This keeps the retained positive low-frequency selector while bounding exposure to recency/action tasks.
spec.grading_accounting_note: Outcome-preserving but canonical-substituting: the helper compresses intermediate target-selection and kwargs-preparation milestones while preserving the final original ToolSandbox side-effect call.

planner_failures: compose target selection with preserved side-effect argument preparation
inadequacy_evidence.summary: Natural expanded60 left the chain visible-not-called. Force-after-search diagnostic called it on two scenarios with positive aggregate outcome and no safety incidents, but the tool returned an empty selected target when update fields were omitted. The repaired version preserves selected target output and prepares downstream kwargs only when updates are available.
visible_data_gaps: visible records plus recency intent plus action updates must become one safe downstream call

inputs.description: Visible candidate record list returned by an already-called search_messages, search_reminder, search_contacts, or similar original lookup tool.
inputs.name: records

inputs.description: Visible numeric timestamp field to rank, such as 'creation_timestamp' for messages or 'reminder_timestamp' for reminders.
inputs.name: timestamp_key

inputs.description: Preserved action to prepare: modify_contact, remove_contact, modify_reminder, remove_reminder, send_message, or generic modify/remove when the selected record type is visible.
inputs.name: action_type

inputs.description: Optional visible field/value constraints to filter records before timestamp ranking; pass an empty dict when no constraint is needed.
inputs.name: constraints

inputs.description: Optional user-supplied or computed update fields such as {'phone_number': '+15551234567'} or {'reminder_timestamp': 1778346000.0}. If omitted, the helper still returns the selected target for later update preparation.
inputs.name: updates

known_failure_mechanisms_addressed: manual latest-or-oldest record selection before action
positive_triggers: latest visible record before modify action
oldest visible record before remove action
spec.reason_tool_is_decisive: It performs the deterministic timestamp selection and returns either safe downstream side-effect kwargs or an explicit abstain reason, which is the critical step in recency-conditioned modify/remove tasks.
